as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="26" value="<b>AWS FIS experiments (FisStack)</b><br>C-1 EC2 instance termination (50%)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;aws:ec2:terminate-instances (tag-based)<br>C-2 EC2 CPU stress (100%, 5 min)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;aws:ssm:send-command / AWSFIS-Run-CPU-Stress<br>C-3 Aurora writer -&gt; reader failover<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;aws:rds:failover-db-cluster<br>C-4 EC2 -&gt; DB blackhole (egress TCP 5432, 5 min)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;aws:ssm:send-command / Run-Network-Blackhole-Port<br><br>Stop condition (shared): ALB 5xx alarm<br>FIS role needs ssm:ListCommands (status polling)<br>C-2 note: the ASG has no scale-out policy, so<br>this run exercises the fault, not scaling" svg.text: FIS Chaos C — CloudFront + Internal ALB + EC2 Auto Scaling Group + Aurora PostgreSQL
EC2-based three-tier web architecture; instance and DB-path faults are injected with EC2/RDS actions and SSM documents
Auto Scaling group (min 2 / max 4, no scaling policy)
C-4 EC2 -> DB blackhole (egress TCP 5432, 5 min)
C-2 note: the ASG has no scale-out policy, so
this run exercises the fault, not scaling
